text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: rollout 'rl-policy-2026-03-14' is reporting a 4xx/429 spike across rl-gateway in us-west-2. Canary traffic shows ~35% increase in throttling. tagging on-call.

incidents-bot: <https://incident-bridge.redwood.example/INC-2026-314|INC-2026-314> created. Severity: P1. Notifying #pager.

ton y_oncall: i’m awake. paging in. seeing alerts. any quick context on what changed?

mira_sre: rollout flipped new policy evaluator + stricter exemptions. feature flag = rl_new_exemptions:false -> true. looks like exemptions got inverted in the flag rollout.

sam_infra: confirming — config diff in the canary shows `exemptions_enabled: false` where prod expected true. this makes system & dedicated accounts subject to token rate limit.

erin_support: customers reporting 429s, top impacted: acct-ded-42 and acct-ded-97. support already triaging high-value tickets.

julia_prod: got an alert from analytics: token-accounting drift for dedciated pools (tokens consumed reported lower than actual). could be double-count/negative adjustment when exemption logic fails.

tony_oncall: ok kill-switch time. flipping feature flag off for rl_new_exemptions. @sam_infra can you patch the flag immediately? if we can't flip quickly -> rollback rollout.

sam_infra: running:
```
cli feature-flag set rl_new_exemptions false --scope production --actor sam_infra
```
- applying to all prod regions. patch deploying now.

mira_sre: before we flip, add temporary allowlist for dedicated accounts so we stop throttling VIPs if flag flip takes >2m. patching rate-limiter config: `allowlist_prefix: "acct-ded-"`

sam_infra: allowlist patch applied to us-west-2; pushing to global.

deploy-bot: PATCH deployed to rate-limiter config in us-west-2 (rev rlim-2026-03-14-a).

erin_support: support confirmed 429s dropping for acct-ded-42 after the allowlist. still seeing errors for other non-dedicated heavy customers.

julia_prod: token-accounting health checks: some counters negative; root cause looks like the new evaluator called the decrement path for exempt tokens because of a logical inversion.

mira_sre: short-term mitigation: 1) allowlist applied 2) flip flag back to previous state 3) rollback the policy rollout for canary -> full if flips don't stabilize.

sam_infra: feature flag flip completed globally. verification: `ffctl status rl_new_exemptions -> false`

tony_oncall: can we run smoke against /v1/generate with header `x-customer-id: acct-ded-42` and check 200s? also run token-accounting probe.

mira_sre: running smoke script now: `./scripts/smoke_rl.sh --customer acct-ded-42 --region us-west-2`

mira_sre: smoke results: 200 OK, token delta returned to normal. token counters increment positive.

erin_support: updating customers: we sent an initial status note to acct-ded-42 and 97. CS wants root cause detail once we’re stable.

sam_infra: rolling back the rollout job to v1-policy config to be safe. command: `deployctl rollback rl-policy --to v1-policy-2026-03-10 --reason "emergency - exemptions inversion"`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for rl-policy; estimated complete 2m.

incidents-bot: paging update: handoff scheduled in 30m to next on-call @mira_sre -> @julia_prod if incident still active.

julia_prod: monitoring dashboards show overall throttling trending back to baseline. some regional lag in eu-west-1 but allowedlist pending there.

mira_sre: action items (short):
- A1: postmortem: track feature flag rollout test coverage around inverted boolean cases (owner: mira_sre)
- A2: write regression test for token-accounting when exemptions toggle (owner: sam_infra)
- A3: emergency allowlist pattern to be added as a deploy-time safety net (owner: tony_oncall)
- A4: CS customer follow-up + credit for impacted windows (owner: erin_support)

tony_oncall: handing off now to @julia_prod for monitoring while I sleep. if throttles spike again, escalate and run `deployctl rollback --id rollback-1812345678` and re-open bridge.

julia_prod: accepted handoff. will keep an eye for 1h and collect logs for the postmortem. linking the bridge notes and relevant runs.

erin_support: adding customer impact summary: window 22:01 - 22:12 UTC, impacted ~8 customers, primary effects: 429s and token accounting discrepancies.

mira_sre: quick root cause summary for notes: feature flag flipped logic inverted exemptions; rollout applied to policy evaluator which caused dedicated accounts to fall under normal token-rate enforcement; token-accounting decrement path executed incorrectly leading to counter drift.

sam_infra: pushed hotfix tests to CI to catch inverted-boolean regressions. creating a policy to require canary for 15m and manual signoff for exemptions toggles.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-314 -> mitigations applied, rollback completed, monitoring stable. Postmortem pending.

tony_oncall: closing my page. nice quick work team :thumbsup:

julia_prod: logging final timestamps and exporting logs to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-314/archived-logs.tar.gz

erin_support: filing follow-up with CS + billing to compute credits.

mira_sre: left TODO: add unit test for token-accounting with `exemptions_enabled` true/false permutations, and add e2e sim that toggles flag during load.

sam_infra: noted. will include in the release checklist.

julia_prod: closing thread for now. will link postmortem when ready.
